doc: A requirement document, CRLF endings, to which an agent added three entries as text, written REQ-NEW, ITEM-NEW and REQ-NEW in place of a number. Each has no usable id and is reported by std.missingId (DESL 5.3.5); under missing: assign it is read with a new id held in memory, in reading order (DESL 5.3.4, 10.2): REQ-0004 for line 9 and REQ-0005 for line 11, each one more than the higher of the mark REQ-0003 and the highest requirement number in the document, which the first new id raises for the second; ITEM-0003 for line 10, after the mark ITEM-0002. ITEM-NEW holds REQ-NEW, so the parent of REQ-0005 is ITEM-0003. The mark line gives the document's attributes lastItem ITEM-0002 and lastRequirement REQ-0003, named here since a fixture's read has no place for them.

attributes.title: A session ends after 30 minutes without activity.
Tokens are refreshed without the user noticing.
A customer pays by card or by bank transfer.
Personal data is kept no longer than it is needed.

steps.doc: A save without an edit writes the bytes that were read: the placeholders are numbered with the next edit that writes the document, never when it is only opened (DESL 5.3.4, FR-013).
steps.expect:
<!-- ded: 0.2 designer: etalii/hierarchical-requirement -->
<!-- last: ITEM-0002 REQ-0003 -->
# Web shop

## Requirements

- ITEM-0001 Backend #core
  - REQ-0001 A session ends after 30 minutes without activity. #security
  - REQ-NEW Tokens are refreshed without the user noticing.
  - ITEM-NEW Payments
    - REQ-NEW A customer pays by card or by bank transfer. category:functional
- ITEM-0002 Data
  - REQ-0002 Personal data is kept no longer than it is needed.

steps.doc: An edit while entries are REQ-NEW and ITEM-NEW numbers them in the same edit (FR-013): a change of REQ-0002's title is the next edit that writes the document, so it writes the id reading gave each placeholder, a replace-value of its group id each (FBL 5.3), and sets the marks to the last of each kind, ITEM-0003 and REQ-0005, in the same transaction, a replace-value of the groups lastItem and lastRequirement on the mark line (DESL 5.3.5, FBL 6.3). The title is a replace-value of its group. Nothing else is touched (FR-025).

attributes.title: Personal data is removed once it is no longer needed.

steps.doc: Undo puts back exactly the bytes the edit replaced: the placeholders and the marks are as they were, so the numbers are given back, and the document is the input again (DESL 5.3.5).
